title: Break Timing Announcement
message:
Hello Elipse Team,

Please note the updated office break schedule, effective immediately:

Monday to Thursday & Saturday: 1:30 PM – 2:30 PM
Friday: 1:00 PM – 2:15 PM

In addition, employees may take a 15-minute prayer break for Asr and Maghrib prayers.

Please note that no other breaks are permitted during working hours unless they have been approved in advance by your Project Manager or Team Head.

We appreciate everyone's cooperation in adhering to these timings to help maintain a productive and efficient work environment.

Thank you.
